title: Optimizing adsorption and photocatalysis for tetracycline and sulfamethoxazole removal: the role of Ag+ and NH4+ in Bi-MOF derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2205-2216
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07287A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vy Anh Tran, Thi Tuong Vi Tran, Tran Thanh Sang, Nguyen Anh Thu, Nguyen Duy Dat, Hieu Vu_Quang, Van Thuan Le, Thu Thao Thi Vo
This study investigates Bi-MOFs and their derivatives (Ag+/Bi-MOF, NH4+/Ag+/Bi-MOF) for photocatalytic degradation of tetracycline and sulfamethoxazole under visible light, demonstrating their efficiency and potential for environmental applications.
